odometry_estimation._comment_init_T_world_imu: Pin GLIM's map frame to the rover spawn so RTK (home-relative) is a direct world prior. base_link at map origin; T_world_imu = T_base_imu (0.264,0.017,0.262 @ yaw pi). [tx,ty,tz,qx,qy,qz,qw]; (0,0,1,0)=yaw pi. Forces NAIVE init (valid on flat terrain). Remove for LOOSE auto-init (non-RTK runs).
odometry_estimation._comment_scan_gate: Kinematic gate on the frame-to-model match. GICP can be CONFIDENTLY WRONG (its covariance stays tight through a 4m divergence), so we check the GICP relative pose vs the IMU-preintegrated prediction; if it disagrees by more than scan_gate_trans/scan_gate_rot in one keyframe, down-weight the scan factors to scan_gate_reject_precision so IMU+RTK carry the frame. Set scan_gate_trans/rot huge to disable.
odometry_estimation._comment_scan_precision: SPLIT relative/absolute scan precision (2026-06-15) to break the divergence-vs-exploration Pareto tension. The scan enters as TWO factors on the smoother: a RELATIVE BetweenFactor(X_last,X_cur) and an ABSOLUTE PriorFactor(X_cur, GICP-map-match). A single scalar (scan_factor_precision) couples them: lowering it below RTK 400 bounds the gradual drift (RTK wins the absolute contest) BUT also guts the relative factor -> noisy odom -> exploration starves (goals 9-17). Mechanism of the drift: the ABSOLUTE prior pulls the pose toward the slowly-drifting iVox map; at 1000 it out-votes RTK (400) 2.5:1 every frame so the pose tracks the biased map and RTK only blunts it (gradual, so RTK never sees a big single-frame residual). FIX: scan_between_precision STRONG (1000, keeps detailed odom for the BEV) + scan_prior_precision WEAK (200 < RTK 400, so RTK sets absolute position and bounds the drift). Between RTK updates the strong relative factor + tight IMU carry motion; at each RTK update RTK out-votes the weak absolute prior 2:1 and re-anchors. scan_factor_precision is now just the fallback default for both.
odometry_estimation._comment_gate_trans: 0.5 -> 0.9 (2026-06-15): at 0.5 the gate MISFIRED on marginal 0.51-0.52m GICP-vs-IMU disagreements (normal-sized corrections) -> it rejected GOOD scans, IMU+RTK drifted ~1.7m -> slam_diverged watchdog aborted the mission at ~18min. The gate can't tell if GICP or the (drifting) IMU prediction is the wrong one; gating a good correction CAUSES drift. 0.9 only catches egregious multi-metre jumps; reject_precision 100 + the smoother crash-guard are the backstops. Set 99 to disable entirely if it still misfires.
odometry_estimation._comment_reject: 0.01 -> 100 (2026-06-15): when the gate fires it down-weights the scan factors to this. 0.01 was near-DEGENERATE -- a burst of rejects left the smoother underconstrained -> gtsam::IndeterminantLinearSystemException -> glim_rosnode SIGABRT (SLAM died ~17min into a long run). 100 still heavily down-weights a bad scan (10x below the 1000 between-precision so IMU+RTK carry the frame) but keeps the linear system well-conditioned. Paired with the smoother-update try/catch crash-guard in odometry_estimation_imu.cpp as a belt-and-suspenders fix.
